reviews.author: Corey Bernas
reviews.text: I needed a last minute tow at 6:00 AM and called Todd’s Roadside. I was told the wait would be under an hour, and Aaron arrived in just 35 minutes!! He was extremely polite and professional, providing true 5 star service. I required a long distance tow out of town, and the pricing was exactly what I expected. I highly recommend Todd and his team, especially Aaron, for his outstanding service!!!

reviews.author: Ramona and Doug Woods
reviews.text: Used my AAA for a tow from Georgetown to Calabash due to engine trouble. Response was quick and service was excellent. Highly recommend. Thank you Andrew!

reviews.author: Fred Gamble Jr
reviews.text: I am in awe with the customer service I received from this company! Using AAA, I heard from Donny within 5 minutes and he was at my house in 25 minutes! Very friendly and professional, he got my truck right out of the ditch. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: DJ Beacon
reviews.text: Hit a huge pothole on Hwy17 North just south of the Georgetown Airport and destroyed our "ride flat" tire. Used AAA and they connected us with Todd's Roadside. Very fast and complete service from Todd's. Donny showed up quickly and was very helpful. Top flight group of people all the way around.

reviews.author: David McGaha
reviews.text: I'm located in Conway, SC and this place was recommended to me. I gave them a call on Monday and they came out and took care of me the next day at a very reasonable rate. I was needing my truck towed to the mechanic and asked them if they were available to come out a day this week and they knocked it out the next day. Very professional service from Ricky B.

reviews.author: I Walts
reviews.text: Excellent communication, excellent service. I called at 6am and they were at my house to pick up my truck quick.

reviews.author: Wesley Byers
reviews.text: The driver arrived promptly, and his service was both courteous and efficient. He only needed to pull the vehicle a short distance, and the total cost was $259.00. While I initially felt the price was a bit high, a subsequent conversation with the owner was very pleasant. I have since revised my rating to five stars and would gladly recommend their services to others and utilize them again in the future.

reviews.author: Bernard Rizzo
reviews.text: After waiting 8 hours for roadside service from AAA with two garages not showing up, Todd's driver arrived in less than an hour to tow my car. He was courteous and professional. Very happy with the service.

reviews.author: John Sparks
reviews.text: Car broke down 20 miles south of Georgetown on a Sunday. Called insurance roadside assistance and screamed at an automated phone system. Was finally told a truck would arrive in 2 hours so I canceled and called Todd's. Spoke to a human, who sent Donnie out in less than 30 minutes. Very reasonable price and excellent service. No one wants to call a tow truck, but Todd's took a lot of the stress away! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: james sullivan jr
reviews.text: I called Todd’s roadside for my parents who live in the Georgetown area. They came out within a few minutes of the call. Performed a jumpstart service and got them back on the road. Highly recommend this company super nice and helpful people for sure!

reviews.author: Rebecca Williams
reviews.text: Mickie Todd was the biggest help! Thank you so much!! If you ever need a tow call Todd’s they are extremely reliable and professional!

reviews.author: Stephen Durgin
reviews.text: Todds towing was great. Mike called me told when he would be there to get my truck and show up on the time he said. He was very polite and quick to get my truck hook up to his tow truck. I would recommend todds towing to anyone. Thanks mike

reviews.author: James Godfrey
reviews.text: Had my bike fall over in the parking lot. Darren drove by and offered to help us great guy great service will call when i am in need bless this business oh lord for all they do to help those in need in Jesus name Amen

reviews.author: Spencer Lockard
reviews.text: Used AAA and Donny at Todd's came to the rescue. Service was fast, efficient, well communicated, and friendly.

reviews.author: david boykin
reviews.text: I would strongly recommend these guys. We were stranded just north of McClellanville on our way back from celebrating Christmas and were struggling to get a tow due to the holidays. Todd's got there quickly and towed us a long distance for a very reasonable rate.

reviews.author: Brian Jones
reviews.text: These guys are very professional and they arrived fast. The rates are reasonable as well. The driver even gave us a ride back to the Air B&B.

reviews.author: Alan Sherlock
reviews.text: Prompt, professional and friendly service. Couldn’t ask for anything more. We needed Todd's Roadside Service and Towing again this time for my wife's car. Once again they didn't disappoint.

reviews.author: Nicole DH
reviews.text: My car started draining coolant about 10 miles from home and I needed a tow to the house so I could fix it. Of course we were out in the middle of the no where and on the side of the road. We got the car to a closed business and they were there in a jiffy. Flat rate and communicated with me throughout the entire process. Even confirmed what I knew, I was just draining coolant out. After crying for awhile, it was really nice that someone was able to make us laugh. I’m sure I’ll get the car apart in the morning and figure out what hose popped off. I’m a chemo patient and have treatment tomorrow afternoon and being able to call someone and having them respond essentially minutes later and not down play anything. Especially when you are a woman that works on her own car… that speaks volumes of them. He didn’t miss a beat. While I hope I don’t ever have to use them again, I will hold onto their information incase I do and will share it with everyone else I encounter. Thank you for helping my kids and I tonight, I greatly appreciate it!

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.text: Praises to Donnie for rescuing us of off a very dark windy road and getting us safely to our hotel in Pawleys.

reviews.author: Sydni Thomas
reviews.text: Mickie was wonderful he was super affordable and showed up super fast! He was kind and even gave us a lift while towing our car!

reviews.author: Shannon Collington
reviews.text: Great customer service, came on time and stayed in contact with me during the process.very pleasant would recommend

reviews.author: Philip M Sawyer
reviews.text: Todd’s Towing has helped our family out on several occasions. Mickie is always pleasant and professional. More importantly, he is always responsive and on time. When it comes to family, he is a true family man. They will offer your little ones a ride in the BIG TOW TRUCK!! That’s huge with 4yr olds! I can’t say enough about this crowd. They have been amazing to deal with. From trucks to sheds to timber, they can haul whatever is necessary. Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Kateland Poston
reviews.text: Great customer service! Always prompt, and makes the towing process run smoothly from start to finish! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Maree Bone
reviews.text: Only company we will use to tow our vehicles. Mickie or his employees always shows up on time when we need them.

reviews.author: Lynn B
reviews.text: Late last night I called all over town and no service would help. I called Todd’s and it took them right at 20 minutes and he even got out of bed to do so. Thank you to the two brothers of Todd’s roadside service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Logan Hensley
reviews.text: Fast and reliable service. Sent them a text and and a picture of my location and they were there in 15 minutes. Very affordable pricing as well 10 stars.

reviews.author: isaac pierce
reviews.text: Todd’s picked up my lowered and modified Subaru. They treated it with extreme care.. they are professional, courteous, and kept me informed of their schedule. They have a great team!
